$schema_info.purpose: Configuration for generating multi-speaker TTS scenarios with Gemini. Pick a difficulty preset, fill in a scenario, then map the values into the Python script.

how_to_apply.director_note: Merge difficulty_presets[level].delivery with each speaker.audio_profile into the '# Director's note' block of the prompt.
how_to_apply.transcript: Flatten scenario.transcript into lines of 'Speaker N: text' joined by newlines, placed under '## Transcript:'.
how_to_apply.transcript_style: Write the transcript itself following difficulty_presets[level].transcript_guidelines. Most listening difficulty comes from the script, not only the voice.

easy.label: Easy

transcript_guidelines.sentences: Short and simple, one idea per line
transcript_guidelines.numbers_and_dates: Stated slowly and in isolation, one per turn

easy.example_line: I need to move on April 14th.

medium.label: Medium

transcript_guidelines.vocabulary: Everyday words plus occasional common idioms
transcript_guidelines.turn_length: One to two sentences per turn

medium.example_line: I need to be out by the 15th, so ideally the 14th of April.

hard.label: Hard

delivery.articulation: Connected speech with some reduced and blended sounds
delivery.disfluencies: Frequent fillers, false starts, mid-sentence restarts

transcript_guidelines.numbers_and_dates: Embedded in fast speech, with at least one self-corrected value
transcript_guidelines.corrections_overlaps: Self-corrections common; mark interruptions with an em dash (—)
transcript_guidelines.turn_length: Two to four sentences, sometimes rambling

hard.example_line: I've gotta be out by the 15th — well, the 14th really, 'cause I need a buffer day.

expert.label: Expert

delivery.accent: Strong regional (Scottish, Irish, or Cockney); may differ per speaker
delivery.articulation: Heavily connected, dropped syllables, trailing off
delivery.disfluencies: Heavy: false starts, mid-thought pivots, trailing '...', filler-heavy

transcript_guidelines.vocabulary: Slang, regional expressions, insider or technical jargon
transcript_guidelines.numbers_and_dates: Multiple values per turn, corrected more than once, buried in tangents
transcript_guidelines.corrections_overlaps: Frequent interruptions and overlaps (mark with —); speakers talk over each other

expert.example_line: Right, so it's the 15th, no wait — the 14th, 'cause, y'know, the landlord wants me gone by the... yeah, the 14th, definitely the 14th.

scenario_template.title: Booking a house move
scenario_template.sample_context: Steady, efficient, and unhurried. Tone is empathetic, crisp, and reassuring.

speakers.audio_profile: A helpful and professional personal assistant.
A busy professional planning a move.
